# GitHub Copilot instructions

This repository is career-kit. This file is a pointer, not the instruction set. Copilot auto-loads it, so it stays thin on purpose. The rules are written once, in their owning files; they are never copied here.

1. Read [`WHAT-THIS-IS.md`](WHAT-THIS-IS.md), the charter. It governs everything.
2. Read [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md), your entry point, and follow it.
3. Story bank work → `spine/AGENTS.md`. Any other util → `utils/<phase>/<util>/AGENTS.md` plus its `00-principles.md`.
4. Never commit, push, or transmit anything from any `my-files/` directory.
